description: Find doctors by procedure/specialty, optionally filtered by US state and city. Uses NavMDs' pre-computed search index (fast, ranked by rating + review volume). Use this when you have a concrete procedure (e.g. 'rhinoplasty', 'botox', 'tummy tuck'). For open-ended natural-language queries, use semantic_search_doctors instead.

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Miami'. This is the area the user asked about, not the user's own location.

state.description: US state name, e.g. 'California' or 'Florida'. This is the area the user asked about, not the user's own location.

name: search_doctors
title: Search doctors by procedure & location
